newsitem.title: BULGARIA: No shares trade on Bulgaria bourses this week.
newsitem.headline: No shares trade on Bulgaria bourses this week.

text.p: No corporate issues traded on Bulgarian bourses this week as brokers refrained from stock market operations until companies meet legal requirements, brokers said.
"Brokers shied away as none of the companies has met the deadline for registering with the Securities and Stock Exchanges Commission to become eligible for floor trading," said a broker.

Under the stock trading law public share companies had to submit by September 19 a detailed report on the size and distribution of their capital and their shareholders to the Securities and Stock Exchange Commission for approval.
Brokers eyed treasury paper instead due to its high yield under the current record high main interest rate of 300 percent annually and low risk, said traders.
Weekly repo turnover on local bourses grew to 7.648 million levs from last week's 4.368 million levs.
The 13-share Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index (RABSI) closed at 41.28 points, unchanged from last Friday.
* RABSI calculated on daily basis since February 1, 1994 -- Dessislava Popova, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
